regime_context: The detector shows Big Banks leading with high durability (0.72) and crowding (z=1.2), passing the absolute-trend gate (gate_helps true). Broad rotation (11 eligible themes) but no single dominant narrative and no confirmed handoff. Momentum ranks are an attention lens, not alpha; the validated edge is drawdown control via the trend gate.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: The absolute-trend gate—the only validated edge—supports maintaining exposure for drawdown control, but high crowding signals limited near-term upside and warrants sizing-down from a naive trend follower. The lean stays with the trend, not because of momentum rank.
evidence: Trend-eligible (gate_helps true; the validated risk-control leg)
theses.dissent: Mixed Hurst tag and crowded positioning could trigger sharp drawdowns if sentiment flips; negative trailing 10-day return (r10 = -0.0062) suggests near-term stalling.

falsifier.text: If the absolute-trend gate flips to ineligible (e.g., breaches a long-term moving average) or durability_bar drops below 0.5 within the horizon, the lean would be re-assessed.

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: A quiet uptrend supported by the validated trend gate and wide breadth, with no crowding stress—offers a more resilient trend-following lean, though momentum rank is modest.
theses.dissent: Mixed Hurst flag and low momentum score suggest returns may be minor; macro backdrop dominated by AI/tech may not benefit utilities, and a rate shock could hit the sector.

falsifier.text: If durability_bar falls below 0.4 or theme becomes ineligible (absolute-trend gate broken) within 30 days, the lean would be disproved.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Trend-gate eligibility allows a lean with low crowding, reducing tail risk; however, narrow breadth and low durability warrant very cautious engagement—more of a risk-controlled exploratory lean.
theses.dissent: Narrow breadth and mixed Hurst mean the trend is fragile and may fail quickly on a commodities price reversal; a single-stock driver can break the theme.

falsifier.text: Invalidated if breadth drops to 0.0 or durability_bar falls below 0.3 within 20 trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
